students.gradeScaleHint: The predictive model was trained on data from Portuguese institutions, whose grading scale is 0–20 (semester grade) and 0–200 (previous qualification and admission grade). When "Brazilian" is selected, values entered on the 0–10 scale are linearly converted to the corresponding Portuguese scale before submission for analysis. The conversion applies exclusively to the four grade fields; all other attributes are unaffected.
students.gradeScaleFieldHint: 0 – 10 (converted to the Portuguese scale on submit)

marital_status.text: Student's marital status at the time of enrollment. Categorical code.

application_mode.text: Admission mode/pathway used in the application to the course. Categorical code — the numeric value identifies the access pathway, with no order or magnitude relationship.

options.label: Holder of another higher education course

application_order.text: Preference ranking assigned to this course by the student at the time of application, among the options indicated.

course.text: Identifier code of the course in which the student is enrolled. This is a categorical identifier; the numeric value does not represent a quantity, grade, or order of magnitude.

previous_qualification.text: Level of qualification/education completed by the student prior to enrolling in the current course. Categorical code.

admission_grade.text: Final admission/application grade for the current course, which determined the student's placement. Theoretical range of 0 to 200, on the same scale as the previous qualification grade.

displaced.text: Indicates whether the student relocated from their home city/region to attend the current program. Binary field.

options.label: No, remains in the city of origin

educational_special_needs.text: Indicates whether a special educational need is recorded for the student. Binary field.

debtor.text: Indicates whether the student has an outstanding financial obligation (debt) recorded with the institution. Binary field.

tuition_fees_up_to_date.text: Indicates whether the student's tuition payments are up to date. Binary field.
tuition_fees_up_to_date.note: Attribute with significant weight in the dropout-risk predictive model.

gender.text: Student's gender, as recorded in the source dataset. Binary field.

scholarship_holder.text: Indicates whether the student is a recipient of a scholarship. Binary field.

age_at_enrollment.text: Student's age, in completed years, at the date of enrollment in the course.

international.text: Indicates whether the student holds a foreign nationality relative to the institution's country. Binary field.

options.label: No, national of the institution's country

curricular_units_1st_sem_credited.text: Number of 1st-semester Curricular Units (CUs) credited through recognition of prior learning — courses waived by equivalence to prior education, without being taken at the current institution.
curricular_units_1st_sem_credited.note: Higher values indicate a greater volume of credit recognition.

curricular_units_1st_sem_enrolled.text: Number of Curricular Units (CUs) in which the student enrolled during the 1st semester.

curricular_units_1st_sem_evaluations.text: Number of assessments (exams/assignments) actually completed by the student in the 1st semester.
curricular_units_1st_sem_evaluations.note: May exceed the number of enrolled CUs, since a single course may have more than one assessment instrument.

curricular_units_1st_sem_approved.text: Number of Curricular Units (CUs) the student passed in the 1st semester.
curricular_units_1st_sem_approved.note: The most relevant academic performance indicator: the higher the value, the better the recorded performance for the period.

curricular_units_1st_sem_grade.text: Student's average grade across the CUs assessed in the 1st semester, on the Portuguese 0-to-20 scale.
curricular_units_1st_sem_grade.note: A value of 0 usually indicates no CUs were assessed in the period.

curricular_units_1st_sem_without_evaluat.text: Number of 1st-semester CUs in which the student remained enrolled without completing any assessment.
curricular_units_1st_sem_without_evaluat.note: High values are an indication of early disengagement from academic activities in the period.

curricular_units_2nd_sem_credited.text: Number of 2nd-semester Curricular Units (CUs) credited through recognition of prior learning — courses waived by equivalence to prior education, without being taken at the current institution.
curricular_units_2nd_sem_credited.note: Higher values indicate a greater volume of credit recognition.

curricular_units_2nd_sem_enrolled.text: Number of Curricular Units (CUs) in which the student enrolled during the 2nd semester.

curricular_units_2nd_sem_evaluations.text: Number of assessments (exams/assignments) actually completed by the student in the 2nd semester.
curricular_units_2nd_sem_evaluations.note: May exceed the number of enrolled CUs, since a single course may have more than one assessment instrument.

curricular_units_2nd_sem_approved.text: Number of Curricular Units (CUs) the student passed in the 2nd semester.
curricular_units_2nd_sem_approved.note: The attribute with the greatest weight in the system's predictive model: low values tend to raise the identified dropout risk.

curricular_units_2nd_sem_grade.text: Student's average grade across the CUs assessed in the 2nd semester, on the Portuguese 0-to-20 scale.
curricular_units_2nd_sem_grade.note: A value of 0 usually indicates no CUs were assessed in the period.

curricular_units_2nd_sem_without_evaluat.text: Number of 2nd-semester CUs in which the student remained enrolled without completing any assessment.
curricular_units_2nd_sem_without_evaluat.note: High values are an indication of early disengagement from academic activities in the period.

unemployment_rate.text: National unemployment rate (%) for the period of the student's enrollment.
unemployment_rate.note: A macroeconomic indicator of the period's context, not an individual characteristic of the student.

inflation_rate.text: National inflation rate (%) for the period of the student's enrollment.
inflation_rate.note: A macroeconomic indicator of the period's context; may take negative values in deflationary scenarios.

gdp.text: Variation of the national Gross Domestic Product (GDP, %) for the period of the student's enrollment.
gdp.note: A macroeconomic indicator of the period's context; may take negative values in economic contraction scenarios.
